This is adequate for gating but reduces observability; expiry (~2036-08-14) was not independently verifiable via the public status endpoint.

/app/backend/native/license.py set_license_key stores only the key string + master_admin_email and seat allocation; it does NOT itself persist owns_* flags. Those flags are persisted via native/router.py's cloud sync into the subscription dict. The split (license vs subscription) is intentional but could be documented explicitly to avoid future confusion.
